# Perseus Computing

> Perseus is the system around the model: current context, governed memory, and reviewable evidence for consequential agent work.

## Platform components

- [Perseus Context Engine](https://perseus.observer/context-engine/): resolves current workspace state into a bounded briefing.
- [Perseus Vault](https://perseus.observer/vault/): preserves governed, time-valid memory in a local service.
- [Perseus Ledger](https://perseus.observer/ledger/): records supplied events, evidence links, and authority references in a verifiable chain.

## Evidence policy

Public figures keep their method, denominator, control, company-run or independent status, limitation, and source. Product behavior, benchmark evidence, security documentation, and procurement posture are separate claim classes.
